answer: We formulate dynamic opportunity-cost bonds requiring ferrous staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay to establish a robust cryptoeconomic primitive. Even if an adversary multiplies identities across a meadow during a gale of requests, subgame-perfect punishment matrices enforce slashing penalties that strictly bound the capital barrier. Consequently, the expected utility of Sybil multiplication evaluates strictly negative, forcing the adversarial multi-agent system into a strict Nash equilibrium where attacks stay unprofitable.
